comment: S1.9: what the payload carries. Production files are copied BY MD5 AT BUILD TIME (no md5 pins on engine binaries: the tie-rule promotion replaces fullgpu.exe + kernel headers; the builder records whatever production holds). Patched files go through the reviewed patch series (base md5 pinned there). Built / new files are pinned to the record of the step that built and tested them. Source keys: GLW = production 'GPU Lightmap Work', H2ROOT = the dev H2EK root, PROJ = this project.

groups.comment: the AO trace engine (gpu_ao trace --engine); its own fullgpu (AO kernels) and ao_merge_parts.py. V1 2026-10-14: the production source is _research/ao/dev_AO2 (= engine_v373 after the TIE1 promotion + exactly dev_AO's AO additions, fullgpu rebuilt on the current headers); the INST dir keeps the name _research/ao/dev_AO (the shell's InstLayout.AoEngineDir; the shell always passes gpu_ao --engine). _research/ao/dev_AO itself is the historical pre-tie engine and is no longer shipped.

gpu_ao.py (P6), ao_seamfix.py and ao_denoise.py (N4, A1) come from the patch steps below, beside ao_ballgrid.py; nothing else of _research\ao ships (the seams verb's ao_seam_* research files need scipy)
gpu_lightprobes.py (P5) comes from the patch step; the lp_* steps it runs
the $W code references P1 moved to $WC = INST (cleanup_farm.ps1 is deliberately NOT shipped: only -Cleanup reaches it and the shell never passes -Cleanup)
